_note: sorcmerc-authored mechanics for data/magic-items.json's potion-* ids (the export is prose only). A potion is drinkable — a combat action, or from the profile stash on the road — only if it is listed here; core/campaign.gd sells and core/loot.gd drops only these. `status` is stored under the potion id in combatant.statuses and read by the keys combat.gd already honours (resist, bonus_damage) plus bonus_to_hit / extra_action / speed_mult / ac / no_attack; `rounds` is its combat life, `minutes` its world-clock life when drunk on the road (adapter.gd carries an unexpired road buff into the next fight). `condition` is a conditions.json id. Unlisted potions (climbing, water-breathing, flying) have no board or road concept here and stay out of the game.

potion-of-poison.text: Looks like healing. It is not: 4d6 poison and Poisoned

potion-of-invisibility.text: Invisible until you attack or cast — attacks against you at disadvantage, yours at advantage

potion-of-speed.text: Haste: an extra action, double speed, +2 AC for 10 rounds

potion-of-resistance.text: Resistance to one damage type, rolled when you drink

potion-of-heroism.text: 10 HP and +2 to attacks and saves (Bless) for an hour

potion-of-giant-strength.text: Strength 21 (Hill Giant): melee attacks and damage use +5 for an hour

potion-of-diminution.text: Reduce: -2 (1d4) weapon damage. Why would you

potion-of-gaseous-form.text: Mist: resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing; no attacks or spells

potion-of-animal-friendship.text: A beast within 30 ft: DC 13 WIS save or Charmed for the fight

potion-of-clairvoyance.text: Your next fight starts scouted: surprise is yours

potion-of-mind-reading.text: Detect Thoughts: advantage on Persuasion at a settlement for 10 minutes
